title: Tower of Pestilence
description:
In an attempt to obtain even more power, a vampire lord accidentally summoned a demon of pestilence inside his dungeon.

Forced to flee to a nearby village's crypts, he resorted to recruiting adventurers to help him reclaim his lair.

Take the role of those heroes and venture forth into the Tower of Pestilence !

Survive hordes of vampiric creatures and demons from a pestilence dimension.

Gather equipment in order to strengthen your characters between each area.

Content :Enjoy a fanciful and monstrous art style.

Simple controls (movement direction + a single skill) allow for any audience to dive into the adventure.

For players looking for more challenges, a difficulty mode is available to try and beat every dungeon area with incremental modifiers on enemies, to test the limits of every character and build !

Features :• 7 playable characters, offering their own different automatic attack and active skill.

• 15 secondary skills to combine during each run.

• 15 areas to explore, varying between 10 and 20 minutes long.

• 5 imposing bosses to challenge.

• 30+ different creatures pitched against you.
description_short: In this bullet-heaven with a fanciful and monstrous art style, explore a dungeon where vampiric creatures and pestilence demons coexist. Play as adventurers with simple controls, improve your gear, and survive the hordes lurking in the tower !
